definitions.atmosphere_rms_nm: pupil RMS of the frame's atmosphere_opd_m after removing the pupil mean (shwfs_ao.core.wavefront.masked_rms), nm OPD
definitions.residual_rms_nm: pupil RMS of pre_update_residual_opd_m (the residual the WFS measured), piston removed, nm OPD
definitions.peak_strehl_*: peak angular surface brightness of the instantaneous 1.65 um image over that of the zero-OPD image of the same propagator and grid (shwfs_ao.science.metrics.peak_strehl_from_discrete_flux); tilt kept, no recentring
definitions.valid_measurement_fraction: effective measurement rows (calibration-valid, runtime-valid, finite) over calibration-valid rows (loop history)
definitions.valid_subaperture_fraction: valid lenslets over retained lenslets (loop history)
definitions.reconstruction_usable: the reconstructor returned an estimate for this frame (loop history); not a lock classifier
definitions.dm_saturation_fraction: fraction of DM actuators whose requested command magnitude exceeds the 1 um OPD stroke limit and is clipped, for the command issued by frame k's update (loop history saturation_fraction[k]); that command is held during frame k + 1, so the correction shown for frame k is the command issued at frame k - 1
definitions.mean_dm_saturation_fraction / max_dm_sat: mean and maximum over the commands issued in frames 200-999 (held during frames 201-1000)
definitions.mean_residual_rms_nm: mean of the per-frame residual RMS over the analysis window
definitions.root_mean_square_residual_nm: square root of the mean per-frame mean square over the analysis window
definitions.mean_instantaneous_peak_strehl_*: mean of per-frame instantaneous peak Strehl over the analysis window
definitions.average_psf_peak_strehl_*: peak Strehl of the equal-weight average of the 800 instantaneous images of frames 200-999 (production long-exposure accumulator); differs from the mean instantaneous Strehl

excluded.post_update_residual: excluded from the main page (same-sample diagnostic)
excluded.lost_lock: the history's final-frame heuristic is not exported as a lock classifier
